# bloated-notes

This skill is padded on purpose. The padding below is filler prose with no
directives, no commands, no paths and no versions in it, so a trim that removes
it is a trim the retention gate is happy to pass.

Filler paragraph 1: this sentence exists to occupy characters and nothing else, and it can be removed without losing anything a reader would otherwise have to reconstruct from scratch.
